kind.description:
What the problem is about.

`manifest` is a plugin manifest that was skipped, or a plugin or entry
that was not found; `value` a value of a session file that is refused,
or that breaks the type or the limits its class declares;
`session` a session that cannot be made or read at all; and `parameter` a
constructor parameter that cannot be described.
kind.title: Kind

where.description: What it was found in: for a manifest, the name of the plugin; for a value, its key path; for a session, the files.
where.title: Where

message.description: What is wrong, as `redsun` logs it.

type.title: Type

required.description: Whether it has no default, so the build fails when nothing fills it.

file.description: Whether a session file may give it instead.
